notes.title: Necrobarista v1.0.8p1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Delivering a minor patch to address a few issues in the Final Pour update that were brought to our attention via the [url=discord.gg/necrobarista]Necrobarista Discord[/url].

If you're loving Necrobarista and/or appreciating the effort we're putting into supporting the game, please leave a Steam review letting us know how you feel - it helps us a whole bunch. ❤︎

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Doors in the Terminal should now correctly unlock for users updating from older save files.
[*]  Fixed letterboxing/clipping issues for users with ultra-widescreen displays.
[*]  Potentially fixed an issue where touchscreen devices would interfere with mouse inputs.
[*]  Fixed black screen soft-lock issue for some users updating from older save files.
[*]  Fixed controller navigations issues inside settings menu.
[*]  Restored the V-Sync setting in the settings menu.
[*]  Fixed an issue with Quality Level preference not being preserved between sessions.
[/list]

[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese voice-over should now play for users who were experiencing issues.
[/list]

If you've come across a bug or issue, or just need help with something, please contact us via the [url=discord.gg/necrobarista]Necrobarista Discord[/url]

notes.title: FINAL POUR: OUT NOW! Patch notes v1.0.8
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=6huLyTx9DCY;full][/previewyoutube]
G'day everyone!
We're proud to announce that our major update, [b]Necrobarista: Final Pour[/b] is [b]OUT NOW for free[/b] on Steam! To celebrate the occasion, we're putting the game on a whopping [b]50% discount[/b]!

Final Pour is the definitive edition of Necrobarista, bringing a year's worth of updates and enhancements to the table, as well as brand new features and stories:
[list]
[*] [b]Full cinematic recomposition[/b] in 1.85:1 aspect ratio, bringing a whole new perspective to the story.
[*] [b]Devil's Den[/b]: A new episode featuring Samantha kicking someone in the head.
[*] [b]Studio Mode[/b]: Compose your own shots, add dialogue, and tell stories using the same tools as us!
[*] [b]Doodle Mode[/b]: Remember those homicidal robots we mentioned before? Now you can draw faces on them! They're fine with it.
[*] [b]Three new additions to the soundtrack[/b] from Necrobarista music producer [b]Jeremy Lim[/b].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32718787/abc966c3830f30da2c8f4181d8ce4107b9488ca5.png[/img]


[h2]NECROBARISTA: FINAL POUR (PC) – Patch Notes Ver.1.0.8[/h2]

[b][h3]ADDITIONS[/h3]
[/b]
[b]Additional Story Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Devil's Den[/b] — New Side Episode is now included in the PC release.
[/list]
[b]Extra Game Modes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Doodle Mode[/b] — Unleash your inner Ashley and draw faces on some homicidal robots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32718787/438de54653fc54d1ef6684f3482a53f7d55af614.png[/img]
[*] [b]Studio Mode[/b] — Compose your own shots, add dialogue, and tell stories using the same tools as us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32718787/ce5af50334858789d47855dac4fc38e619ccef2a.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Additional Music:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 x new tracks composed by music producer Jeremy Lim have been added into the game.
[/list]
[b]Gallery Art:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new gallery art. These are unlocked after reading Key Memories required to progress the Main Story.
[/list]
[b]Tutorials:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tutorials explaining Memories and Exploration Mode.
[*] Added system messages for unlocking certain game content.
[/list]

[b][h3]CHANGES[/h3]
[/b]
[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game view is now displayed in a 1.85:1 cinematic aspect ratio.
[*] Several changes made to camera composition for certain Episodes.
[/list]
[b]Unlocking Memories (Short Stories):[/b]
[list]
[*] Memories are now unlocked after progressing through the Main Story.
[*] The legacy "Keywords / Fragments" currency from the original 2020 game release is no longer required to unlock & read Memories.
[/list]
[b]Unlocking Side Episodes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Side Episode "Walking to the Sky" now becomes unlocked after completing Episode 4: "End of the Line".
[/list]
[b]Exploration Mode:[/b]
[list]
[*] Characters can now be interacted with in Exploration Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32718787/a199bb4cba93ed338146eaebe25bf10db3dc99cd.png[/img]
[*] Maddy is now present at the front cashier counter. Speak to Maddy to continue the story.
[*] [b]※NOTE: Maddy will not appear in Exploration Mode if the player has just finished the Epilogue and has yet to replay any Episodes post-game.[/b]    
[*] Holding down either [Mouse Right-Click] or [Gamepad Right Trigger] now displays the locations of Memories.
[/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated UI for several menus.
[*] An on-screen button named "The Terminal" is available in both the Title Screen and the Pause Menu. Selecting this button allows access to Exploration Mode.
[/list]
[b]Studio Mode:[/b]
[list]
[*] Set a maximum cap of 20 shots for the Studio Reel.
[*] Added a radial menu, which can be used to navigate between different panels when using a gamepad (hold down Left Bumper + Directional Button).
[/list]

[b][h3]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[/b]
[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved game stability.
[/list]
[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated lighting and VFX across the entire game.
[*] Fixed visual bugs for certain Episodes.
[/list]
[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved support for gamepads.
[/list]
[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Revised English and Japanese scripts for certain parts of the Main Story.
[*] Revised English and Japanese scripts for the Side Episode "Walking to the Sky."
[*] Revised English script for a select few Memories (short stories).
[*] Minor localizaton fixes for several languages.
[*] Game Language can now only be changed from the Title Screen.
[*] Changed the language order for Language Selection in the Title Screen's Config menu.
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated game credits.
[*] Other bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32718787/217e2559a8a9f2fbd822051498892bcf1b05bf43.png[/img]

[h2]Looking at the Future[/h2]

First of all, the Route 59 team would like to give a [b]big thank you[/b] to all of the players who have enjoyed and supported Necrobarista since launch. It has been amazing seeing all of the positive feedback the game has received, and it's really helped out the team over the past year.

Final Pour is intended to be the 'final' major update for Necrobarista. We're very proud of it and believe that it matches our original vision for what we wanted the game to be. Of course, never say never, but this will be the last major update for the game in the foreseeable future.

It's been a wild ride over the past 7 years of development and the whole team will be going on a short and well deserved break after this launch. Rest assured that this won't be the last you hear from us; we've been cooking up some pretty cool things here in the studio that we cannot wait to share when they're ready :)

Until then, we hope you enjoy Necrobarista: Final Pour!

notes.title: Post-Launch Update (Thank You!)
notes.notes:
It's now been a few days since Necrobarista's PC launch, and we've been absolutely swamped with your impressions, your fan-art, your screencaps, your memes, and—most importantly—your love. Releasing a game that you've been working on for five years is a pretty big deal, and we're so glad to finally be able to share Necrobarista with the world. We can't thank you enough for the support, but as a sign of our appreciation, we'd like to announce...

[h2]Necrobarista will be getting FREE post-launch DLC![/h2]

That's right - Necrobarista will be getting a bunch of gameplay and story additions, with the latter focusing on side characters who appeared briefly during Necrobarista's story. Maddy's story is finished for now, but if you were wondering about those troublesome teens Tuan and Hannah, or the secretive and sultry Samantha, or that guy from the OP with the waistcoat and cigar, wonder no further: we'll be telling those characters' stories as well. Starting later this year, we'll be releasing several(!) DLC chapters at no extra cost, telling side stories set within the Terminal featuring these characters. Stay tuned for more info!

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

We're currently still working on optimizing the game for a broader range of setups, and broadening the configuration options available to players. Two patches have been released so far (as well as a smattering of hotfixes), and a third will be releasing today.

Simultaneously, however, our content team is working on the free DLCs. The first one will be purely gameplay oriented, with a rework of the [b][REDACTED][/b] system and the addition of a [b][REDACTED][/b]! If you're interested in the development history of Necrobarista, this will be a cool one.

After that, we'll start to release details of the story DLCs. Stay tuned! We're thrilled to have the opportunity to share more of Necrobarista's world with you.

[b][ [url=https://twitter.com/route59games]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://discord.gg/necrobarista]Discord[/url] ][/b]

Talk soon.

❤,
Route 59

Hey everyone!

Following on from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/725270/announcements/detail/2736451422504647636]our last update[/url], Necrobarista v1.0.2 is now available, containing fixes for a number of user-reported issues, as well as new config options and input refinements. [list]

[*]Mouse cursor is now confined to application window while Necrobarista is focused.
[*]Necrobarista now indicates when autosaving events occur. Shot progression during episodes is still recorded (and saved) silently.

[h3]Performance Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Performance improvements for title screen.

notes.title: Pre-Launch Development Update
notes.notes:
Dearest friends, fans, and other interested parties,

The finish line is in sight. Everyone at Route 59 is absolutely busting to release Necrobarista into the world, and—good news—we're almost certain that it'll be soon. Very soon, even. Lots of wheels are in motion, and this tram ain't stopping for nobody.

First, though, here's the rundown of where we're at generally:
[list]
[*]Localization on all of the fourteen languages we're shipping in is on the cusp of being complete; only minor tweaks remain. Everyone involved in localization has worked [i]incredibly[/i] hard and fast to get the job done, and we're both super impressed and very thankful for them.
[*]Most of us are currently focusing on diligently playtesting and addressing bugs and performance issues—as our screenshots and gameplay footage demonstrate, Necrobarista is a graphically complex game, and we're doing our best to ensure it looks great and runs smoothly on a broad range of setups. We'll be delivering further optimizations post-launch, too.
[*]Necrobarista has been to two different conventions in the past month: Gamescom and Tokyo Game Show! We had a wonderful reception at both, and would like to extend special thanks to our Japanese publishing partner PLAYISM for doing a great job of demoing the game at TGS (as always).
[*]Now we're making preparations for PAX Aus 2019! Expect new merch and a booth full of overcaffeinated game developers. 
[*][b][i]Most importantly[/i][/b], even though we're working our butts off, we're making sure to take care of ourselves and not burn out in the last stage of development. It's an easy pitfall to trip into, but thankfully our producer is on the hunt for anyone working after hours. Believe me, there have been (gentle) scoldings.
[*]Please don't break the window. The air conditioner is on and we are listening to our favourite music. 🐕
[/list]
Now, here's a list of serious and not-so-serious questions that I gathered from our [url=http://discord.gg/necrobarista]Discord[/url] and [url=http://twitter.com/route59games]Twitter[/url]:

[h1]Frequently (Recently) Asked Questions[/h1]
[b]Q: Are you still going to release Necrobarista in Q3, aka before the end of September?[/b]
A: That was the original expectation, but it's not looking likely at this point.

[b]Q: It's still coming before Christmas, though, right?[/b]
A: At this point we cannot foresee a situation where that is not the case. We're pushing very hard to have the game out ASAP.

[b]Q: Will there be a demo or a preorder?[/b]
A: These are both things we've put a lot of thought into. Ultimately, a polished demo would take extra development time, and we're close enough to releasing the full game that it's not a good use of our time to go back and cut bits out of it for a demo build. As for a preorder, well, it's a big logistical challenge that we'd probably want to tackle a bit earlier in the development cycle—as with the demo, we don't really think it would be worthwhile to launch a preorder so close to release.

[b]Q: I saw your company logo in a big tech company's presentation recently.[/b]
A: This seems like less of a question and more of a comment.

[b]Q: C'mon. ಠ_ಠ[/b]
A: We have nothing new to announce at this time. Sorry! We might have some neat things to talk about soon, though. Keep an eye on our social media. (Links at the bottom of this post!)

[b]Q: What about that bangin' Kevin Penkin soundtrack?[/b]
A: That'll drop within a week or two of the game's Steam release, via our partners [url=https://bossbattlerecords.com/]Boss Battle Records[/url]. As before, keep an eye on our social media to stay informed on where you can listen to the [i]extremely sick beats[/i] that our audio team cooked up.

[b]Q: Switch & PS4 ports?[/b]
A: 2020.

[h1]Looking Forward to Release[/h1]
Speaking from the heart here, it's been a long journey for all of us. A good chunk of the Route 59 team has been working towards this game release for [i]five years[/i] at this point, and I don't think any of us would have made it this far without the encouraging and gratifying groundswell of support from our little passionate fanbase. What I'm trying to say is that we appreciate you a whole lot, and every decision we make is in service of providing the best possible game for you at launch. Thank you for your patience. More soon. ❤

notes.title: Coffee-powered ghost story Necrobarista has a release date
notes.notes:
A couple of years ago at PAX Australia I had a chance to play a demo of Necrobarista, a visual novel about serving coffee, meeting ghosts, and playing with knives. The setting is a cafe called the Terminal, a magic coffee shop that serves both the living and the dead. 

After five years of development, most of which I assume went into those slick animations as seen in the new trailer above, Necrobarista will finally be released this year, either on August 8 or August 9 depending which part of the world you're in (check your local version of its Steam page to find out for sure). 

Necrobarista's cool art, bizarre story, and strong sense of place made it stand out back when I played that demo. Here's hoping the final thing lives up to it.
